title: REPT with a count of zero returns an empty string

source.quote: If NumberOfTimes is 0 (zero), REPT returns an empty string.
If num_times is 0 (zero), REPT returns a blank.

derivation: Zero repetitions of "ab". DAX Guide says the result is an empty string; the example table on Microsoft Learn shows an empty cell for a count of 0.
alternative: Microsoft Learn says "returns a blank": if that means BLANK rather than an empty string, the value is BLANK (null).
